models.name: Qwen3-0.6B

prefill512.method: P2 anchors, one boot/head, per-layer KV corrections, latest v3 times, arithmetic v3 event costs

audit.softmax_curve_model: measured cost at c1,c2,c513,c514; linear per-event energy interpolation c2..513
audit.m_work_model: fixed short-prefill projection work per token; exact head once; matched groups across contexts

scope: covered subtotal and conditional arithmetic scenarios; not complete chip power or 512-token measurement
limitations: No new full 512-token execution or long-prefix energy validation.
Latest v3 timing does not supply new full-position circuit activity; energy curves are transferred from existing counters and calibration.
Softmax energy and DDR command/row-policy between measured endpoints are interpolated, not directly calibrated at all contexts.
MoE real prompt routing, hybrid intermediate states, input-dependent toggles and actual arithmetic footprint remain conditional.
Read DMA measured power, unmatched controls, global clock/interconnect and DDR PHY/board remain outside covered totals.
No 200MHz timing signoff; prior M 300MHz timing violations are not certified fixed by frequency scaling.
